1. HeroSectionBookingWidget
   Purpose: First impression + immediate booking.
   Suggested Text:

Main Headline: "Travel Cash-Free with a Simple QR Scan"
Subheadline: "Book tours, hotels, transport & experiences in Bangladesh. Pay with bKash, Nagad or any QR — no cash, no worries."
Supporting line (below form): "Join thousands exploring Cox’s Bazar, Sylhet, Bandarban & more — completely hassle-free."

CTA on form: "Search Tours & Tickets" or "Find Cashless Packages"
Visual Ideas:

Background: Beautiful drone shot of a scenic spot (e.g., Sajek Valley or Cox’s Bazar beach) with a large floating QR code overlay and a phone showing successful payment.
Foreground: Smiling Bangladeshi travelers (diverse ages) holding phones, scanning QR at a gate or hotel.
Hand-drawn style option: Clean line art of a suitcase, phone with QR, and a crossed-out cash bundle.

2. FeatureGrid (features={features})
   Purpose: Highlight key benefits right after hero.
   Suggested Text Structure (4-6 feature cards):

Card 1: "QR Code Tickets & Entry"
Text: "Scan once and enter — no paper tickets, no queues."
Icon: Phone scanning QR at a tourist gate.
Card 2: "Fully Cashless Payments"
Text: "Pay for everything with bKash, Nagad, cards or bank QR. Never hunt for an ATM again."
Card 3: "Instant Booking & Confirmation"
Text: "Real-time availability for tours, buses, trains & ferries."
Card 4: "Secure & Trackable"
Text: "All transactions protected. Track every payment in your wallet."
Card 5 (optional): "Digital Wallet for Travel"
Text: "Store all your tickets, passes & receipts in one app."

Visual Ideas:

Clean grid with vibrant icons + short illustrations.
Hand-drawn: Simple icons like a phone with green tick, crossed cash notes, shield for security, map pin.
Photos: Real people using phone at different locations (hotel reception, bus counter, boat terminal).

3. HotelDeals
   Purpose: Showcase accommodation deals with cashless angle.
   Suggested Text:

Section Headline: "Stay Comfortably — Pay QR, Rest Easy"
Subheadline: "Handpicked hotels & resorts with instant cashless check-in across Bangladesh."
Badge on each deal: "Cashless Ready • Instant Confirmation"

Visual Ideas:

Photos: Attractive hotel rooms, swimming pools, with overlay phone showing QR check-in.
Hand-drawn: Cozy bed + phone with QR code floating nearby.

4. TransportTickets
   Purpose: Bus, train, ferry, launch, flight bookings.
   Suggested Text:

Headline: "Travel Smoothly Across Bangladesh"
Subheadline: "Book buses, trains, launches & CNGs — Get QR tickets instantly. Board without cash stress."
Each ticket card: "Dhaka → Cox’s Bazar | ৳850 | QR Ready"

Visual Ideas:

Photos: People boarding bus/launch happily scanning QR on phone.
Hand-drawn: Bus/train icons with QR code on the door.

5. TourSuggestions (tours={suggestedTours})
   Purpose: Personalized or popular tour packages.
   Suggested Text:

Headline: "Curated Cash-Free Adventures"
Subheadline: "From weekend getaways to multi-day tours — everything booked and paid with QR."
Each tour card: Title, duration, price, "Cashless Experience Included" badge + short description highlighting no-cash convenience.

Visual Ideas:

Stunning destination photos (Sundarbans, Kuakata, Rangamati) with a small QR + phone icon in corner.
Hand-drawn option: Illustrated map route with QR checkpoints.

6. CommunitySection (buddies={buddies})
   Purpose: Find tour buddies / group travel.
   Suggested Text:

Headline: "Find Your Travel Buddies"
Subheadline: "Join or create groups for safer, more fun, and shared cashless trips."
Features: "Chat • Split QR payments • Group bookings"

Visual Ideas:

Photos: Groups of friends laughing, taking selfies at tourist spots, or scanning QR together.
Hand-drawn: Diverse people icons connected by lines + phone in the middle.

7. Testimonials
   Purpose: Social proof — most powerful for trust.
   Suggested Text (3-5 quotes):

"I went to Sylhet without carrying a single note. Everything was QR — game changer!" — Rashed, Dhaka
"No more ATM lines in remote areas. The QR tickets made our family trip so relaxing." — Nadia & Family
"Finally a platform that understands Bangladesh travel realities." — Karim, Chittagong

Visual Ideas:

Real user photos (or stock with Bangladeshi faces) + their trip photos.
Hand-drawn: Speech bubbles with simple avatar illustrations.

8. NewsletterSection
   Purpose: Capture emails for marketing.
   Suggested Text:

Headline: "Stay Updated on Cashless Travel Deals"
Subheadline: "Get weekly tour offers, new destinations & QR payment tips straight to your inbox."
CTA: "Subscribe Now" (with privacy note)

Visual Ideas:

Clean illustration of envelope/phone with QR codes raining down.
Background: Subtle map of Bangladesh.

Bonus: Sections on Guides, Wallets & Deals
You mentioned these — here are quick suggestions:
Digital Wallet / Guides Section:

Headline: "Your All-in-One Travel Wallet"
Content: Show how users store QR tickets, make payments, get refunds, and access offline guides.

Special Deals Section:

Headline: "Limited Cashless Offers"
"Book this week & get 10% extra cashback on QR payments"

General Design Recommendations (PC + Mobile)

Color scheme: Green (trust + money), teal/blue (travel), white/cream background.
Icons: Consistent QR code + phone icon throughout.
Mobile: All sections should stack vertically. Use larger touch targets. Consider making FeatureGrid horizontal scroll on mobile.
Illustrations: Mix real photos (for trust) with friendly hand-drawn icons (for approachability). You can generate these with tools like Grok Imagine, Midjourney, or hire a local illustrator.
Consistency: Repeat the slogan "No Cash. No Hassle. Just Scan & Go." in header, footer, and multiple sections.
